entries.question: How do I sign up?
entries.answer:
You can get a key here!
https://arkheron.com/en_US/play/

entries.question: How do I report a bug?
entries.answer: Press CTRL+B while in game to open the bug report window.

entries.question: When is the release date?
entries.answer: No exact release date has been announced, but the game is planned for release by the end of the year.
